title: moeb-tool-origin failed: ToolSearch and Read used without MissingMoebTool signals
description: ToolSearch was used multiple times to load deferred moeb tool schemas (start_spec, write_file, patch_file, read_file, enter_phase, verify_rubrics, complete_review, get_run_status, push_thinking_blocks, git_commit, tag_run, create_branch, grep_files, read_file_range). The external Read tool was used to read the start_spec result file (194KB, saved to disk by the kernel due to size). No MissingMoebTool signals were buffered for any of these calls. This is a recurring pattern across multiple spec sessions.
proposed_resolution: Buffer MissingMoebTool signals immediately after each ToolSearch and Read call per the Tool Origin Policy. ToolSearch is tracked in a5000047-0604-4000-8001-000000000001; large-output Read is tracked in f0bf5e4b-0001-4001-8001-000000000001.
